===Relegation/promotion playoffs=== The 17th and 18th placed teams in the relegation table (San Martín (San Juan) and San Lorenzo, respectively) played the 3rd and 4th-place finishers of the [[2011–12 Primera B Nacional]] season (Instituto and Rosario Central, respectively); the winner of each claiming a spot in the following Primera División season. The Primera División team (''Team 1'') played the second leg at home with sporty advantage if the aggregate would have been drawn. Both San Lorenzo and San Martín (San Juan) remained in the [[Argentine Primera División|Primera División]]. The fifth Copa Libertadores berth was given to the best team in the Copa Sudamericana who has not already qualified otherwise. Qualification to the Copa Sudamericana was determined through the same aggregate table as the Copa Libertadores.
